name: DaxLib.SVG.Element.UseDef
description: Reference a previously defined SVG element with optional positioning and styling This function is used to reuse elements that have been defined using `DaxLib.SVG.Def.*` functions (e.g., `DaxLib.SVG.Def.Circle`, `DaxLib.SVG.Def.Rect`, `DaxLib.SVG.Def.Paths`, etc.). Instead of duplicating element definitions, use the appropriate `DaxLib.SVG.Def.*` function once and then reference it multiple times with `DaxLib.SVG.Element.UseDef`.

parameters.name: defId
parameters.description: The identifier of the defined element to use

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Optional: X position where the element should be placed

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Optional: Y position where the element should be placed

parameters.name: transforms
parameters.description: Optional: Transformation to apply (can be generated with `DaxLib.SVG.Transforms`)

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Element.UseDef' =
		(
			defId: STRING,
			x: STRING = BLANK(),
			y: STRING = BLANK(),
			transforms: STRING = BLANK()
		) =>

			"<use" &
			" href='#" & defId & "'" &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( x ), " x='" & x & "'" ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( y ), " y='" & y & "'" ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( transforms ), " transform='" & transforms & "'" ) & 
			"/>"
